name: claude-usage-monitor
description: Claude Code 5-hour and weekly limits, tokens by day, model and project, alerts and a pace forecast in the status bar. Unofficial. Русский / English.

claudeUsage.language.description: Interface language. auto follows the editor language (Russian or English).

claudeUsage.showFiveHour.description: Show the 5-hour limit in the status bar.

claudeUsage.showWeek.description: Show the weekly limit in the status bar.

claudeUsage.showToday.description: Show tokens spent today in the status bar.

claudeUsage.showResetTimer.description: Show the time until the 5-hour window resets next to its percentage.

claudeUsage.warnAt.description: Percent at which the status bar turns to a warning.

claudeUsage.critAt.description: Percent at which the status bar turns red.

claudeUsage.notifications.description: Notify when a limit crosses the warning / critical percent.

claudeUsage.notifyOnReset.description: Notify when a limit that was in the warning zone resets.

claudeUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often the status bar re-reads the data, in seconds.

claudeUsage.syncFolder.description: Optional folder shared between your devices (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Syncthing…). Each device copies its usage files there and adds up the others, so "today" covers all devices. Leave empty to stay on this machine.
